name: dumen
description: AI agents inspect a small interpretability core: amplification_scan detects TLCM amplification regimes across an alpha sweep; sae_summary runs a sparse autoencoder forward pass and reports MSE, cosine reconstruction and top-K features; steering_status reports the registered steering-vector state and Steer-to-Target Projection geometry; kv_drift simulates cumulative KV-drift decay; archive writes a compressed JSON proof bundle to a caller-supplied path (never under the repo). Every tool returns a structured GREEN/RED JSON proof, never an exception. Heavy deps (torch) are optional — the server stands up without them and a missing dep is a RED reason, not a crash.

DUMEN_MCP_ARCHIVE_DIR.description: Kanit-arsafi cikis-dizini ( yalnizca archive aracinin yazma-yolu; bos ise archive RED doner).

tools.name: version
tools.description: dumen --version karsiligi: dumen.__version__ + torch-yer-tespiti (sunucu agir bagimliliklar olmadan da ayakta kalir; torch eksikse torch_ok=false olarak isaretlenir). SALT-OKUMA. Donus: {ok, dumen_version, torch_ok, torch} - ok=false RED.

tools.name: amplification_scan
tools.description: TLCM amplifikasyon-rejim tesbitini calistirir (dumen.core.amplification.scan_amplification + select_alpha + refine_alpha; arXiv:2609.07876). Alpha taramasi boyunca |cos| egrisini olcer, |cos_after| > |cos_before| rejimini isaretler ve guvenli-alpha sinirini (safe_alpha_max) dondurur. SALT-HESAP - hicbir dosyaya degmez, sentetik 64-boyutlu vektorlerle (CLI: dumen amplification-scan). Donus: {ok, amplified, first_amplified_alpha, safe_alpha_max, recommended_alpha, ...} - amplifiye durumlarda ok yine true'dur (bu bir TESPIT aracidir, amplifikasyonu onlemez).

tools.name: sae_summary
tools.description: SAE (SparseAutoencoderEngine) ileri-gecisini + yeniden-insa kalitesini ozetler: MSE, kosinus-yeniden-insa ve en-aktif TopK ozellikler (inspect_activations). SALT-HESAP - save_pretrained YOK (yazma-yolu izolasyon gerektirir). Donus: {ok, n_features, k_sparsity, mean_squared_error, cosine_reconstruction, top_features, ...}

tools.name: steering_status
tools.description: SteeringEngine'in kayitli yonlendirme-vektor durumunu ve tek-vektor StTP (Steer-to-Target Projection) geometrisini ozetler: kayitli vektorlerin listesi ve steer-oncesi/sonrasi |cos| hizalanmasi (azalmali). SALT-HESAP. Donus: {ok, registered_vectors, cos_before, cos_after, invariant_holds, ...}

tools.name: kv_drift
tools.description: KVDriftGuard'i simule eder: her token-adiminda yonlendirme farkini zamansal-sonumlemeyle birlestirir (record_and_decay), birikimli sapma normlarini ve get_drift_metrics ciktimini verir. Gecicidir - HICBIR dosyaya veya repo-alti state'e yazmaz. Donus: {ok, drift_norms, final_metrics, soft_clip_engaged, ...}

tools.name: archive
tools.description: Bir JSON kanit-paketini zlib ile sikistirip cagiricinin verdigi output_path'e yazar ve geri-okuyarak butunlugu dogrular. IZOLASYON: output_path (veya DUMEN_MCP_ARCHIVE_DIR env'i) ZORUNLU - verilmezse RED doner; asla repo-alti varsayilan yere yazmaz. Donus: {ok, output_path, bytes, sha256_prefix, roundtrip_ok}

output_path.description: yazilacak .jsonz dosya-yolu (mutlak onerilir) - ZORUNLU; yoksa RED
